mapper.select: SELECT e.id AS excerpt_id,e.attachment_id,e.origin,e.run_id,e.segment_id,e.created_at FROM material_excerpt e JOIN material_attachment a ON a.owner_id=e.owner_id AND a.id=e.attachment_id AND a.sha256=e.attachment_sha256 AND a.status='READY' WHERE e.owner_id=#{owner} AND e.id=#{excerptId}
